description: This file defines the RootTabs SwiftUI view for an iOS application, managing a tabbed interface with status overlays, voice wake functionalities, and gateway actions.

classes.name: RootTabs
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that provides a tabbed interface with overlays and voice wake toast notifications.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main view layout including tab items, overlays, and gesture handling.

methods.name: gatewayStatus
methods.description: Computes the current status of the gateway based on the app model.

methods.name: statusActivity
methods.description: Builds and returns the current status activity state for UI display based on app Model and voice wake settings.
